name: Baggage Claims MK1, Rev D slim tag (CR2032 + 1 F buffer): parts envelope for the enclosure
source: work/tag/revD/ENGINEERING.md section 4; geometry in src/tagd_gen.py (the numbers here are the generator's constants)
status: Nothing here is measured. basis: 'page' = read on a maker's or reseller's page on 22 Nov 2026; 'typical' = a common size, unverified; 'design' = chosen here; 'assumed' = shape not given by the maker.
supersedes: docs/design/baggage-claims-device-envelope.json (2 x AA, 60 x 80 x 42) for the slim tag only; that file is unchanged.

frame.y: along the tag, 0 = bottom, strap end up, 0..92
frame.z: thickness, 0 = front face (perforations, coin-cell door), 12.8 = back face (card, tracker door)

parts.name: AirTag-style tracker (no maker's name on the product)

pocket.door: bayonet in the back plate, opening 32.9, flange 36.0

parts.name: Speaker 28 mm, 4 ohm, 3 W (PUI Audio AS02804PR-N50-R)
parts.basis: page (diameter, seated height, 4 ohm, 3 W, 76.5 dBA at 3 W / 1 m); rim 2.0 and 24 dia body assumed
parts.mounting: rim on a 0.5 foam gasket (23 ID) on the front skin, held by three printed fingers with lips; sealed back chamber about 5.6 cm3
parts.grille: 61 holes 1.3 dia on a 2.6 hex lattice inside the gasket: 78 mm2

parts.name: CR2032 lithium coin cell
parts.mounting: printed cup in the front skin under a bayonet door (opening 20.8); two springs on the board's front side (centre -, rim +)

parts.name: Supercapacitor 1 F, 2.7 V (Eaton HV0810-2R7105-R)
parts.mounting: two printed saddles; leads through a notch in the zone wall to the board

parts.name: Custom board, 2 layers, 0.8 FR-4
parts.components: back side (toward the plate) up to 1.2 high, keep 3.2 clear at the +x edge for S1 and S2; front side: the two cell springs only
parts.mounting: four printed posts under, four pads on the back plate over (clamped)

parts.name: Off switch, side-actuated SPDT slide (C&K PCM12 class)
parts.at: board's +x edge, y 50.2; lever reaches to 0.5 under the right-hand edge in a 3.1 x 1.6 slot

parts.name: Mode button, side-actuated tactile (SKRT class)
parts.at: board's +x edge, y 68.0; plunger 0.5 under the edge in a 1.9 hole

parts.name: Name-and-address card, laminated
parts.at: back plate pocket, 0.3 all round, under 1.5 lips; window 47.6 x 29.6

thicknessStack.what: clearance to the door bosses' plane

airlineLimit: device lithium <= 0.3 g metal or <= 2.7 Wh (IATA DGR Table 2.3.A; FAA PackSafe baggage with lithium batteries), read 22 Nov 2026; CR2032 = 0.07 g
appNote: The app's Baggage Claims schematic and BOM still describe the Rev B (2 x AA) parts; they need updating to these parts later.
